WireInfo


Wire data that can be specified per line segment phase, or for the line segment as a whole in case its phases all have the same wire characteristics.

  • WireInfo
  • OverheadWireInfo
  • CableInfo
  • TapeShieldCableInfo
  • ConcentricNeutralCableInfo
root anyOf WireInfo

WireInfo

Type: object

Wire data that can be specified per line segment phase, or for the line segment as a whole in case its phases all have the same wire characteristics.

 No Additional Properties

root anyOf WireInfo CableInfo.isStrandFill

isStrandFill

Type: boolean

True if wire strands are extruded in a way to fill the voids in the cable.

root anyOf WireInfo WireInfo.sizeDescription

sizeDescription

Type: string

Describes the wire gauge or cross section (e.g., 4/0, #2, 336.5).

root anyOf WireInfo WireInfo.insulationThickness

insulationThickness

Type: object or number

(if insulated conductor) Thickness of the insulation.

 No Additional Properties

root anyOf WireInfo IdentifiedObject.aliasName

aliasName

Type: string

The aliasName is free text human readable name of the object alternative to IdentifiedObject.name. It may be non unique and may not correlate to a naming hierarchy.
The attribute aliasName is retained because of backwards compatibility between CIM relases. It is however recommended to replace aliasName with the Name class as aliasName is planned for retirement at a future time.

root anyOf WireInfo IdentifiedObject.mRID

mRID

Type: string

Master resource identifier issued by a model authority. The mRID is unique within an exchange context. Global uniqueness is easily achieved by using a UUID, as specified in RFC 4122, for the mRID. The use of UUID is strongly recommended.
For CIMXML data files in RDF syntax conforming to IEC 61970-552, the mRID is mapped to rdf:ID or rdf:about attributes that identify CIM object elements.

root anyOf OverheadWireInfo IdentifiedObject.aliasName

aliasName

Type: string

The aliasName is free text human readable name of the object alternative to IdentifiedObject.name. It may be non unique and may not correlate to a naming hierarchy.
The attribute aliasName is retained because of backwards compatibility between CIM relases. It is however recommended to replace aliasName with the Name class as aliasName is planned for retirement at a future time.

root anyOf OverheadWireInfo IdentifiedObject.mRID

mRID

Type: string

Master resource identifier issued by a model authority. The mRID is unique within an exchange context. Global uniqueness is easily achieved by using a UUID, as specified in RFC 4122, for the mRID. The use of UUID is strongly recommended.
For CIMXML data files in RDF syntax conforming to IEC 61970-552, the mRID is mapped to rdf:ID or rdf:about attributes that identify CIM object elements.

root anyOf CableInfo IdentifiedObject.aliasName

aliasName

Type: string

The aliasName is free text human readable name of the object alternative to IdentifiedObject.name. It may be non unique and may not correlate to a naming hierarchy.
The attribute aliasName is retained because of backwards compatibility between CIM relases. It is however recommended to replace aliasName with the Name class as aliasName is planned for retirement at a future time.

root anyOf CableInfo IdentifiedObject.mRID

mRID

Type: string

Master resource identifier issued by a model authority. The mRID is unique within an exchange context. Global uniqueness is easily achieved by using a UUID, as specified in RFC 4122, for the mRID. The use of UUID is strongly recommended.
For CIMXML data files in RDF syntax conforming to IEC 61970-552, the mRID is mapped to rdf:ID or rdf:about attributes that identify CIM object elements.

root anyOf CableInfo IdentifiedObject.name

name

Type: string

The name is any free human readable and possibly non unique text naming the object.

root anyOf TapeShieldCableInfo IdentifiedObject.aliasName

aliasName

Type: string

The aliasName is free text human readable name of the object alternative to IdentifiedObject.name. It may be non unique and may not correlate to a naming hierarchy.
The attribute aliasName is retained because of backwards compatibility between CIM relases. It is however recommended to replace aliasName with the Name class as aliasName is planned for retirement at a future time.

root anyOf TapeShieldCableInfo IdentifiedObject.mRID

mRID

Type: string

Master resource identifier issued by a model authority. The mRID is unique within an exchange context. Global uniqueness is easily achieved by using a UUID, as specified in RFC 4122, for the mRID. The use of UUID is strongly recommended.
For CIMXML data files in RDF syntax conforming to IEC 61970-552, the mRID is mapped to rdf:ID or rdf:about attributes that identify CIM object elements.

root anyOf ConcentricNeutralCableInfo IdentifiedObject.aliasName

aliasName

Type: string

The aliasName is free text human readable name of the object alternative to IdentifiedObject.name. It may be non unique and may not correlate to a naming hierarchy.
The attribute aliasName is retained because of backwards compatibility between CIM relases. It is however recommended to replace aliasName with the Name class as aliasName is planned for retirement at a future time.

root anyOf ConcentricNeutralCableInfo IdentifiedObject.mRID

mRID

Type: string

Master resource identifier issued by a model authority. The mRID is unique within an exchange context. Global uniqueness is easily achieved by using a UUID, as specified in RFC 4122, for the mRID. The use of UUID is strongly recommended.
For CIMXML data files in RDF syntax conforming to IEC 61970-552, the mRID is mapped to rdf:ID or rdf:about attributes that identify CIM object elements.

root anyOf ConcentricNeutralCableInfo WireInfo.insulated

insulated

Type: boolean

True if conductor is insulated.
